description: List the templates in the connected Templated account, 25 per page by default (max 100), optionally filtered by name (query), size (width, height) or tags. Use this first to find the template ID for create_render, get_template_layers or update_template. Returns each template's id, name, size, thumbnail, folder, and layer and page counts.

includeLayers.description: Include each template's layers (a much larger response; get_template_layers reads one template's layers)

query.description: Search query to filter templates by name

name: list_templates
